fact_dependencies.claim: The generic conception uses only explicitly fictional rules.
fact_dependencies.rationale: No external factual claim is required to evaluate the workflow.

interviews.heading: Intent
interviews.value: A drought-struck valley must decide whether an ancient communal canal charter still governs a newly discovered spring.

interviews.heading: Subject
interviews.value: The subject is how shared stewardship survives when private survival rewards breaking a public promise.

interviews.heading: World
interviews.value: Water moves only downhill through hand-built gates; opening one district's gate reduces every downstream allotment.

interviews.heading: Character
interviews.value: A young gate keeper and an exiled surveyor begin as legal opponents and become reluctant custodians of the same watershed.

interviews.heading: Causality
interviews.value: A forged flood warning can be defeated only by comparing upstream marks, council seals, and the physical travel time of water.

interviews.heading: Narrative boundary
interviews.value: Whether the valley should abolish inherited water rank after the emergency remains unresolved.
